tagline.en: Tencent ARC's camera-controlled world model — turn a single image into video you can steer with camera moves.
tagline.zh: 腾讯 ARC 的镜头可控世界模型——把一张图片生成为可用相机运动来操控的视频。

en: VerseCrafter is a world model from Tencent ARC that generates video from a still image while letting you drive the virtual camera. It sits at the intersection of image-to-video generation and 4D scene control, so instead of just animating a picture you can specify how the viewpoint moves through the scene.

It builds on a Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone and adds camera-conditioned rendering, drawing on a geometry model (MoGe) to keep the scene coherent as the camera moves. The result is video generation with explicit control over camera trajectory rather than motion left entirely to chance.

In WorldFoundry you run VerseCrafter through the shared pipeline: provide an input image and a camera path, and it renders a video that follows that viewpoint. Note that the upstream release is research-only and non-commercial, and is not intended for use in the EU.
zh: VerseCrafter 是腾讯 ARC 推出的世界模型,它从一张静态图片生成视频,同时让你操控虚拟相机。它处于图生视频与 4D 场景控制的交汇点——你不只是让画面动起来,还能指定视角如何在场景中移动。
它以 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干为基础,加入了相机条件化渲染,并借助几何模型(MoGe)在镜头移动时保持场景连贯。由此,视频生成对相机轨迹拥有明确控制,而不是把运动完全交给随机。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 VerseCrafter:给它一张输入图片和一条相机路径,它会渲染出沿该视角运动的视频。请注意,上游发布为研究用途、非商业许可,且不适用于欧盟地区。

whenToUse.en: Reach for VerseCrafter when you want to animate a still image with deliberate camera motion — dolly, orbit, or push-in shots — rather than uncontrolled generation. It fits camera-driven and world-model exploration workflows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让静态图片按刻意设计的相机运动(推、拉、环绕等)动起来,而非放任式生成时,VerseCrafter 很合适。它适合以相机为主导的世界模型探索类工作流。

notFor.en: Not for commercial use — the upstream license is research-only and excludes the EU. It also depends on separately downloaded checkpoints, so plan for the download.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业使用——上游许可仅限研究,且排除欧盟地区。它还依赖单独下载的 checkpoint,请预留下载时间。

en: Camera-controlled image-to-video with explicit trajectory control
Built on a Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone plus geometry guidance
Positioned as a world model, not just a clip generator
zh: 镜头可控的图生视频,支持明确的轨迹控制
基于 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干,并辅以几何引导
定位为世界模型,而非单纯的片段生成器
仅限研究、非商业许可(不适用于欧盟)
